notes: v1.14.564 — THE DEVICES LIST CARRIES THE U POSITION. RACK-ELEVATION-DEMOTE Ship 1, the additive half: nothing is removed and the elevation and its minimap are untouched, so for one verified ship the list and the drawing state the same U positions side by side and the phone check can confirm they agree before anything goes. ⭐ SCOPE WAS CORRECTED BY MEASUREMENT BEFORE ANY EDIT: S-1 asked that every device row GAIN a U element, but :41800 has emitted one since v1.6.97 — re-shipping that would have been churn, so the ship narrowed to what was actually missing and says so. WHAT SHIPS: (S-3) DEVICES opens by default — it is now the primary home of the U data and cannot hide behind a closed disclosure; (S-2) rows sort U descending, top of rack first, matching how a tech reads a rack standing in front of it; (S-4) the row clears the 44px Cold Aisle floor via min-height:var(--tap-s) with border-box, and the U value is set at 14px; (S-1) the U label now matches rackElevation_buildHtml (:40944) and scrubbar_buildHtml (:41188) exactly — en dash, U on both ends — and an unrecorded position renders `U —` instead of rendering nothing. ⛔ CONTRACT B10 IS THE POINT OF THAT LAST ONE: absent and not-recorded used to look identical to a tech; the em dash says which one it is and never guesses a number. ⚠ S-2 SORTS A COPY — rack.slots is the persisted array off deploy_loadRacksFor, and sorting it in place would rewrite stored order as a side effect of rendering. ⚠ THE ROW STAYS NON-INTERACTIVE: S-4 also asked that the tap target be the full row, but the row has no action defined and Contract B14 forbids a control that does nothing, so the row is sized to the floor and left non-tappable. Reported, not silently taken either way. ⚠ Display stays BLOCK: the row's contents are concatenated inline, and a flex container would promote each fragment to its own flex item and stack them.
